MoreSpace/Industries/Hospitality/Hotels & resorts

More direct bookings, faster check-ins and no lost requests

For city hotels, resorts and boutique properties, we connect the PMS, channel manager and WhatsApp so inquiries get live-rate answers, guests pre-check-in before arrival, foreign guest filings are tracked, requests reach the right team, and every review gets a considered reply.

What makes hotels & resorts different

  • Direct inquiries arrive after hours and drift to OTAs while the desk is busy with arrivals.

  • Check-in queues form while staff collect IDs and retype details into the PMS and the Form III portal.

  • Housekeeping and maintenance requests move by phone and radio, with no shared view of what is open.

  • Group and corporate RFPs need room blocks, rates and meeting space checked across systems before anyone can reply.

  • OTA prices sometimes undercut the direct rate through promotions, wholesale leakage or room mapping errors.

Where automation helps hotels & resorts

  • Live-rate replies on WhatsApp and the website

    Answer room inquiries with real availability and the direct rate from the booking engine, where it exposes an availability API, send a booking link with the dates filled in, and hand anything negotiated to reservations.

  • Pre-arrival concierge and digital pre-check-in

    Approved pre-arrival messages with directions and check-in time, plus a secure form for arrival time, ID details and priced extras such as airport transfers or early check-in.

  • Form III preparation and deadline tracking

    For foreign nationals, particulars are collected in advance, verified at the desk and laid out for the Bureau of Immigration portal, with alerts before the twenty-four-hour arrival and departure deadlines.

  • Requests routed with response targets

    WhatsApp and room QR requests become department tickets with timers, guest updates and escalation to the duty manager.

  • Rate consistency checks and group RFP handling

    A daily OTA exception list for the revenue manager, and RFP extraction with room block availability and proposal drafts for the sales team.

  • Review replies drafted by AI, approved by a manager

    Draft replies for Google and OTA reviews, approved by the guest relations or general manager, alongside private feedback that opens recovery cases before the guest leaves.

Discover and inquireStandard3–5 weeks

Direct booking inquiry desk

Answer room inquiries from WhatsApp, Instagram, website chat and email with live rates and availability, offer a direct booking link, and pass group, long-stay and corporate requests to sales with the details already captured.

Hotels & resorts

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Direct inquiries often arrive outside office hours or while the reservations desk is busy with arrivals. Guests who wait for a reply book through an OTA instead, and the hotel pays commission on a guest who wanted to book direct. Group and corporate inquiries sit in personal inboxes without follow-up.

Trigger

A new message on the hotel's WhatsApp Business number, Instagram account or website chat, including chats started from the Google Business Profile website link, or an email to the reservations inbox.

How it runs

  1. Capture the inquiry into one queue with source, language and contact preference, and check whether the person has opted in to messages.
  2. Extract dates, guest count, room preferences and purpose with an AI classifier, asking one short follow-up question when something essential is missing.
  3. Query the booking engine or channel manager for live availability and the public direct rate, where the system exposes an API; the reply never quotes a price the system did not return.
  4. Reply within the 24-hour service window with room options, inclusions, cancellation terms and a direct booking link with the dates filled in.
  5. Route groups above an agreed room count, long stays, corporate rates and special requests to the reservations or sales owner with a conversation summary.
  6. Send one approved follow-up template to opted-in guests who have not booked, then close the inquiry with a reason code.

Human checkpoint

Reservations staff own any negotiated rate, discount, group quote or exception to policy. The assistant shares only rates and availability returned by the booking engine and hands over when it is unsure or the guest asks for a person.

What we deliver

  • Live-rate reply flow connected to the booking engine
  • Handover rules for groups, long stays and corporate requests
  • Approved WhatsApp templates and follow-up rules

How we measure it

  • Median first response time to direct inquiries
  • Inquiry-to-booking conversion by channel
  • Share of inquiries handed to a person
  • Direct booking share of room nights

Discover and inquireStandard3–4 weeks

OTA rate consistency watch

Check every day that the prices guests see on OTAs and metasearch match what the hotel loaded, flag undercuts and stale inventory, and give the revenue manager a short exception list instead of a spreadsheet to scan.

Hotels & resorts

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Rates loaded through the channel manager do not always display as intended. OTA-funded promotions, wholesale rates leaking to retail sites, room mapping errors and closed dates showing as open undercut the direct channel or cause overbookings, and manual checks across sites and dates rarely happen consistently.

Trigger

A scheduled daily run, plus an on-demand run after a rate or restriction change in the channel manager.

How it runs

  1. Pull the hotel's loaded rates and restrictions for an agreed window of stay dates from the channel manager or PMS rate plans.
  2. Import displayed prices for the same dates and room types from the hotel's licensed rate-shopping tool or channel manager parity report, plus Google Hotel Center price reports where the hotel takes part, through their exports or APIs.
  3. Normalize taxes, meal plans, cancellation terms and occupancy so every comparison is like for like.
  4. Flag exceptions beyond an agreed tolerance: OTA price below direct, rooms selling on closed dates, or mismatched room mapping.
  5. Send the revenue manager a ranked exception digest in Slack or email with evidence links and the likely cause.
  6. Log each exception, the action taken and the resolution date for the monthly review with OTA market managers.

Human checkpoint

The revenue manager decides every rate change and every conversation with an OTA or wholesaler. The automation never changes rates, restrictions or inventory on its own.

Quote, confirm and payAdvanced5–8 weeks

Group, MICE and wedding inquiry desk

Turn group RFPs, corporate offsites and wedding inquiries into qualified opportunities with a checked date, a tentative hold that expires on schedule, and a proposal draft built from approved packages for the sales manager to finalize.

Hotels & resorts · Event & wedding venues

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Group and event inquiries carry large revenue but need many details: dates, room blocks, function space, menus, guest counts and budgets. They arrive as PDFs, forms, calls and WhatsApp messages. Tentative holds are forgotten and block dates, proposals take days, and double bookings of a lawn or ballroom are a real risk.

Trigger

An RFP email, website event form, WhatsApp inquiry or planner lead tagged as group, corporate event or wedding.

How it runs

  1. Extract event type, dates and flexibility, guest count, room block, function space, food and beverage needs and budget from the message or attached RFP using AI, flagging gaps.
  2. Ask the client for missing essentials through a short form, then score fit against agreed rules such as minimum spend, peak dates and space capacity.
  3. Check function space and room block availability in the banquet calendar and PMS, showing conflicts and alternative dates.
  4. Place a tentative hold with an owner and expiry date, remind the client and the owner before it expires, and release the hold on expiry unless the owner extends it.
  5. Draft a proposal from approved packages, menus and policies with indicative pricing for the sales manager to edit.
  6. On approval, send the proposal and a payment link for the advance, and convert the hold to definite when the signed contract and advance arrive.

Human checkpoint

The sales manager approves fit, pricing, concessions and the proposal before it goes out, and the revenue manager signs off room block rates on high-demand dates. Contract and cancellation terms are confirmed by the person authorized to sign.

Prepare for arrivalAdvanced5–7 weeks

Pre-arrival messages, digital pre-check-in and Form III support

Send each booked guest an approved pre-arrival WhatsApp message with a secure pre-check-in link, collect arrival time, ID details and consented extras before arrival, and give the front desk a verified queue and a Form III deadline tracker.

Hotels & resorts

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Check-in queues form because staff collect ID, address and arrival details at the desk, then retype them into the PMS and, for foreign guests, into the Form III portal under a twenty-four-hour deadline. Extras such as airport transfers and early check-in are offered inconsistently or not at all.

Trigger

A confirmed reservation in the PMS, with timed messages at agreed points before arrival and a reminder on the arrival day.

How it runs

  1. Receive the reservation from the PMS, check the guest's messaging consent and preferred language, and schedule the sequence: WhatsApp for opted-in guests, email or DLT-registered SMS for the rest, including most OTA bookings.
  2. Send an approved utility template with check-in time, directions, contact details and a secure link to a pre-check-in form on the hotel's own domain.
  3. Collect arrival time, guest names, address and ID details on the form; for foreign nationals, collect the passport and visa particulars Form III needs, storing uploads encrypted.
  4. Offer priced extras such as an airport transfer, early check-in or an upgrade with the full price shown upfront; send marketing offers only to guests who opted in.
  5. Write confirmed details to the PMS profile where the PMS exposes an API, or prepare them for staff to enter, and give the front desk an arrivals queue showing what is complete and what is missing.
  6. After ID verification, lay out each foreign guest's Form III particulars in portal order and track the arrival and departure filings with alerts to the front office manager.

Human checkpoint

Front desk staff check the original ID or passport at arrival before anything is filed, and a named front office user submits Form III on the Bureau of Immigration portal. Extras that need a decision, such as early check-in on a full night, are confirmed by the front office manager.

Tools

WBWhatsApp Business PlatformNNext.jsSSupabasenn8nRRetool

Systems it connects

  • PMS (for example OPERA Cloud, IDS Next, eZee Absolute or Hotelogix)
  • Bureau of Immigration Form III portal
  • Hotel booking engine
  • Payment gateway for prepaid extras

Data & consent

IDs and passports are collected only on the secure form, never in chat or AI prompts, and are visible to front office roles only. Form III records are kept electronically for at least the one year the Immigration and Foreigners Rules require, then deleted per hotel policy. Aadhaar is never the only accepted ID, and masked or QR-verified Aadhaar is preferred to full copies.

What we deliver

  • Approved pre-arrival template sequence
  • Secure pre-check-in form on the hotel domain
  • Front desk arrivals queue with verification status
  • Form III deadline tracker with alerts
  • Extras catalog with upfront pricing

How we measure it

  • Pre-check-in completion before arrival
  • Median check-in time at the desk
  • Form III filings within twenty-four hours of arrival
  • Extras accepted per arriving guest
  • Arrivals with missing particulars

Stay, dine, travel or celebrateStandard4–6 weeks

In-stay request routing with SLA alerts

Let guests send requests on WhatsApp or through a room QR code, turn each into a ticket for housekeeping, maintenance, food and beverage or the front desk, and escalate to the duty manager when a response target is missed.

Hotels & resorts

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Requests reach the front desk by phone and are relayed by radio or personal WhatsApp. Staff forget, shifts change, and the hotel learns a request was missed only when the guest complains at checkout or in a review. Managers cannot see which teams are overloaded.

Trigger

A guest message on the hotel's WhatsApp number during the stay, a QR form submitted from the room, or a request logged by staff.

How it runs

  1. Match the message to the in-house reservation and room number so the guest does not need to repeat details.
  2. Run keyword rules first so safety, medical, security and harassment messages go straight to the duty manager with a call alert, then classify the rest by department and urgency with an AI model, sending unclear ones to the front desk.
  3. Create a ticket in the operations queue with a response target for the request type, and notify the on-shift owner on their device.
  4. Acknowledge the guest with the expected time and update them when the ticket is marked done, using an approved utility template if the 24-hour service window has closed.
  5. Escalate to the supervisor and then the duty manager when a target is missed, and flag repeat issues by room for maintenance.
  6. Report requests, response times and breaches by department and shift for daily briefings.

Human checkpoint

Department staff resolve and close tickets. The duty manager owns escalations, anything involving safety, security or health, and any compensation. Guests can ask for a person at any point in the conversation.

Feedback and recoveryStandard3–5 weeks

Feedback, service recovery and review replies

Ask every guest for private feedback after a stay, meal, trip or event, open a recovery case when something went wrong, invite every guest to review without filtering, and draft replies to public reviews for a manager to approve.

Hotels & resorts · Restaurants & cloud kitchens · Travel agencies & tour operators · Event & wedding venues

Open the automation blueprint

The problem

Unhappy guests often say nothing until they post a review, and happy guests rarely write one unless asked. Replies to Google, OTA and aggregator reviews are slow or generic, and some businesses ask only satisfied guests for reviews, which Google's review policies prohibit.

Trigger

Checkout in the PMS, a closed bill or delivered direct order, a trip's return date or the day after an event, plus each new public review on a connected platform.

How it runs

  1. Send a short private feedback request through an approved template or email, timed for each segment; aggregator orders are left out because the platform holds that customer relationship.
  2. Open a recovery case for low scores or complaint keywords, assigned to the guest relations, outlet, consultant or event manager with a response target.
  3. Send every eligible guest the same review invitation regardless of their feedback score, with no incentive attached.
  4. Collect new public reviews from Google Business Profile and other connected sources, and classify sentiment, topics and any serious allegation.
  5. Draft a specific, courteous reply in the brand voice from the review and approved facts, and route serious allegations such as food safety, discrimination or injury to the general manager.
  6. Post the approved reply through the Google Business Profile API where connected, or give the approver a copy-ready reply for the OTA or aggregator extranet.

Human checkpoint

A named manager edits and approves every public reply and decides every refund, compensation or goodwill gesture. Allegations involving safety, health, discrimination or legal threats go to the general manager or owner before any response.
